summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited first-quarter 2026 results. The filing details operational and financial performance, including a 9% increase in hydrocarbon production, exceptional exploration discoveries, and a raised share buyback program from ~1.5 bln to 2.8 bln. It also mentions a demerger of Plenitude and a JV with Petronas. This is a routine earnings release and does not constitute a special situation event as defined. No terms, premiums, or deal mechanics are present.
